title: 第5章 刁蛮少女贺娅娇第6章 练拳的老者
content_zh:
“娇娇，别急，爸妈这不正在收拾吗？待会就将这些全部扔出去。”
少女旁边，站着一位中年和一位妇女，中年西装革履，皮鞋发亮，全身上下无一不是名牌，实际上能住在山水别墅区的人，都非富即贵。妇女不过四十一二，看上去风韵犹存，年轻时候一定是一个美人坯子，不然也生不出这样俏皮可爱的女儿。
“那个……你们这样处理我的东西，问过我的意见吗？”
张逸风本来不想开口，但这一家三口似乎还没有发现他的到来。
“你是……”|中年男女这才发现张逸风，表情疑惑地开口。
张逸风看着三人，淡淡道：“我就是你女儿口中的那个没有品位的人。”
中年一听，微微一愣，随后笑了，颇有礼貌地道：“原来你就是前任租客，冒昧了，娇娇说的话你不要放在心上。”
中年一看就是做大事的人，对张逸风还算客气。
但不是每个人都像中年这么有素质，比如这位千金小姐。
“哼，我就说你没品位怎么了？你看你买的衣服和被套，花花绿绿的，不知道的人还以为你是伪娘呢。”
“娇娇，怎么说话呢？”中年男子瞪了少女一眼，但这眼神明显没有杀伤力。
“爸，我说的实话嘛。你来了正好，将你这些东西赶紧收拾了走人，我要重新布置了。”
虽然张逸风本来就是来收拾东西的，但少女这态度，让他心里不爽，他看了少女一眼，冷笑道：“该走人的是你们吧？这里是我的地方，我同房东的合约，还有七天才到期。”
“这……”
张逸风的话让三人一愣，中年男子更是拿起了电话，拨通了房东的号码。
“什么？还有七天才到期，你怎么不告诉我们？人家一直没回来你也得先告诉我们。行了，先这样。”
中年挂了电话，脸色有些不爽，随后他笑着朝张逸风道：“你是小张吧？对不住了，房东以为你不会回来了，所以没有告诉我们这事情。这样吧，这别墅这么大，我们忙活了两天，将买的东西都置办过来了。现在让我们另找地方住，实在有些累人，不如我们一起住如何？这七天房租，我额外付你。”
“爸，为什么要另外付房租，我们也签了合同。”少女有些不乐意，嘟着嘴不满地开口。
“闭嘴。”
中年喝了一声，少女这才闭上了嘴巴，看得出来，中年虽然溺爱少女，却也不是对她百依百顺。

张逸风思考了一下，他现在的确正缺钱，这里的别墅按天计算，是两千到五千一天，一周怎么也得有一两万。这对以前的张逸风来说，不过是一件衣服钱，但对于现在的他来说，却是过日子的钱。
当然，这些钱张逸风不会用来过日子，他要用钱生钱，他会用这些钱买一些药材，来熬练药汤。这一个月，张逸风除却修炼外，经常去图书馆研究药材，他发现地球的药材虽然同灵月大陆不同，但有些药材药理和药效是相通的，虽然这些药材比不得灵月大陆，但总比没有的好。张逸风打算通过炼药，将修为提升到淬体第二层。
“我这个人习惯了一人住。”
张逸风开口了，就算心里已经同意了，嘴上也不能第一时间表现出来。两世为人，他可不是嫩头青。
“你……我爸都同意给你钱了，你还想怎样？”少女那刁蛮的暴脾气又上来了，当时就怼了张逸风。
content_en:
"Jiaojiao, don't worry, aren't your parents cleaning up right now? They'll throw them all out later."
Next to the girl, stood a middle-aged man and a woman. The middle-aged man was wearing a suit and shiny leather shoes. Everything about his body was brand-name. In fact, people who can live in the Shanshui Villa area are either rich or noble. The woman is only forty-two years old, but she still looks charming. She must have been a beauty when she was young, otherwise she would not have given birth to such a cute and cute daughter.
"Um...have you ever asked me for my opinion when you handle my things like this?"
Zhang Yifeng didn't want to speak at first, but the family of three didn't seem to notice his arrival yet.
"You are..."|The middle-aged man and woman discovered Zhang Yifeng and spoke with doubtful expressions.
Zhang Yifeng looked at the three of them and said calmly: "I am the person with no taste in your daughter's mouth."
When the middle-aged man heard this, he was slightly startled, then smiled and said politely: "So you are the previous tenant. You are being presumptuous. Don't take what Jiaojiao said to heart."
At first glance, the middle-aged man is someone who does big things, so he is quite polite to Zhang Yifeng.
But not everyone is as qualified as middle-aged people, such as this wealthy lady.
"Hmph, I said you have no taste. What's wrong? Look at the clothes and quilt covers you bought. They are so colorful. People who don't know would think you are a transvestite."
"Jiaojiao, what are you talking about?" The middle-aged man glared at the girl, but his look was obviously not lethal.
"Dad, I'm telling the truth. You came just in time, so pack up your things and leave. I'm going to rearrange them."
Although Zhang Yifeng was originally here to pack things, the girl's attitude made him feel unhappy. He glanced at the girl and sneered: "It's you who should leave, right? This is my place, and my contract with the landlord will expire in seven days."
"This..."
Zhang Yifeng's words stunned the three of them. The middle-aged man even picked up the phone and dialed the landlord's number.
"What? It's only due in seven days. Why didn't you tell us? You have to tell us first if they haven't come back yet. Okay, let's do this for now."
The middle-aged man hung up the phone, his face a little unhappy, and then he smiled and said to Zhang Yifeng: "Are you Xiao Zhang? I'm sorry, the landlord thought you would not come back, so he didn't tell us about it. Well, this villa is so big, we have been busy for two days and bought all the things we bought. Now let us find another place to live, which is really tiring. How about we live together? I will pay you extra for these seven days of rent."
"Dad, why do you have to pay extra rent? We also signed a contract." The girl was a little unhappy and spoke dissatisfiedly.
"Shut up."
The middle-aged man drank, and the young girl closed her mouth. It was obvious that although the middle-aged man doted on the young girl, he was not obedient to her.
Zhang Yifeng thought for a while and found that he was indeed short of money now. The villas here cost 2,000 to 5,000 per day, which means they only cost 10,000 or 20,000 per week. For Zhang Yifeng in the past, this was just money for a piece of clothing, but for him now, it is money for living.
Of course, Zhang Yifeng will not use the money to live. He will use the money to make money. He will use the money to buy some medicinal materials to make medicinal soup. This month, in addition to practicing, Zhang Yifeng often went to the library to research medicinal materials. He found that although the medicinal materials on Earth were different from those in Lingyue Continent, some medicinal materials had similar pharmacology and efficacy. Although these medicinal materials were not as good as those in Lingyue Continent, they were still better than nothing. Zhang Yifeng plans to improve his cultivation to the second level of body tempering through refining medicine.
"I'm used to living alone."
Zhang Yifeng spoke, but even if he agreed in his heart, he couldn't show it immediately with his mouth. As a human being in two lifetimes, he is not a young person.
"You...my dad has agreed to give you money, what else do you want?" The girl's unruly temper came back, and she attacked Zhang Yifeng at that time.
